subject: ceri-clairmont
label: Both palms, both directions
field: Cyrena Clairmont · the Blood-Sharing, and the trade under it
from: BLOOD-WITCH and RED OATH filed as register — atmosphere, ritual flavour, a woman who marks devotion through touch and teeth
to: IT IS A LEARNED TRADE, A MARRIAGE RITE, AND A SCAR IN EACH OF THEIR RIGHT PALMS.
note:
THE TRADE FIRST, BECAUSE IT IS THE PART THAT MAKES THE REST SAFE. SHE WAS TAUGHT EROTICIZED BLOODLETTING BY HER TRIBE: HOW TO CUT, TEND, CLEAN AND TASTE WITHOUT CAUSING HARM. Four verbs, in order, and THE TENDING IS INSIDE THE SKILL rather than appended to it as an apology. The people who taught her that later exiled her, which is the shape of her entire life in one sentence.

IT IS ALSO WHERE HER APPETITE LIVES. Blood is her centre, plainly. And Destiny loves it — loves being covered, and loves that THE MARKS ARE HERS TO KEEP. She chooses which ones stay. THE BLOOD-BLOOM CONSORT WAS NEVER A DECORATIVE TITLE and the Archive had been reading it as one.

THE MARRIAGE. Her tribe weds by BLOOD-SHARING, right palm, where a ring sits in Fairbrooks — and in the tribal form THE MAN GIVES, WHILE INSIDE HIS MATE. One cut, one direction. Another rite with a sorting in it, on a woman there was no category for.

SO THEY BOTH DID IT. While Ceri was inside her, DESTINY LAPPED CERI’S PALM, THEN CERI LAPPED DESTINY’S. Two cuts, two givers, both halves of a one-way rite performed simultaneously by two women who each refused to be only one of them. THEN CERI TENDED THE CUTS, because she was taught to.

BOTH KEPT THE SCARS. Silver now, in the right palm of each, visible to anyone looking at the ring hand.

MARRIED BY CLAN LAW THAT NIGHT. LIVI FILED THE PAPERWORK AFTERWARD so Fairbrooks would agree, and THE ORDER OF THOSE TWO FACTS IS THE WHOLE POINT — the marriage was real before the county heard about it. The woman who marries every couple on this compound served here as a CLERK to a rite that did not need her, because a thing being real is not the same as a thing being safe.

AND THE ARCHIVE PUT CERI AT SIX THREE AS THE TALLEST WOMAN IN THE HOUSEHOLD. SHE IS THE TALLEST BRAT. BRYN IS 6′4″, one inch over her, and the record has said so since the first build. EIGHTH INSTANCE.
